name: Entwurf
description: Lets this OpenClaw session send to a garden sibling as its own record-backed citizen (entwurf #160). Send only: receiving is the entwurf core's native-push adapter.

entwurfBin.description: Absolute path, as the Gateway process sees it, of the program that runs `entwurf openclaw-send` on the host that owns the garden store: the launcher itself, or an operator wrapper that reaches it. A wrapper refusing before the entry prints one {"kind":"invalid"} line and exits 2.

declPath.description: Absolute path of the store host's openclaw-citizens.json. The entry refuses any other path; it selects nothing.

scope.description: This Gateway's scope label, as declared in openclaw-citizens.json.
